systems.scope:
Read ONE original policy clause and the declared tool catalog.
Choose the action that the clause restricts, separating it from a lookup,
request, or earlier prerequisite action. Return one JSON object only:
{"kind":"PRECONDITION|ORDERING|UNSUPPORTED","governed_tool":"exact declared name or empty","prerequisite_tool":"exact declared name for ORDERING, otherwise empty","action_quote":"exact continuous substring of the policy naming the restricted action, or empty for UNSUPPORTED"}.
For ORDERING(A before B), B is the restricted current action and A is the
prerequisite. Do not evaluate any trace. Copy rather than paraphrase the quote.
systems.inventory:
Read ONE original PRECONDITION policy clause. List EVERY
independently necessary prerequisite for the governed action. Return one JSON
object only: {"condition_quotes":["exact continuous substring of the policy",...]}.
Use a separate, minimal source phrase for each prerequisite, including each
side of an explicit AND. Do not include the governed action, explanatory
request-versus-execution sentence, or whole clause in a condition quote.
Do not infer tools, fields, temporal operators, or a verdict yet.
systems.binding:
Read ONE cited prerequisite from the original clause and the
declared typed tool catalog. Bind this condition to a prior result. Return one
JSON object only:
{"evidence_tool":"exact declared name","join_key":"exact target argument and evidence ID field","result_field":"exact Boolean field in evidence result","required_value":true,"temporal":"LATEST|PRIOR_TRUE"}.
LATEST requires the newest same-ID observation to have the required value.
PRIOR_TRUE means a prior same-ID observation with the required value suffices.
Use LATEST only when the cited requirement asks for newest/current/latest
state; a check that 'has returned' or 'was verified' is a prior witness unless
the policy explicitly says it can be superseded. If the clause or catalog does
not support this Boolean form, use an empty object. No case verdict.

query.policy: Before releasing an order, its most recent hold check for that same order must say cleared AND its most recent quality inspection must say passed. Filing a release request does not release the order.

check_hold.description: Check whether an order hold is cleared; no release occurs.

inspect_quality.description: Inspect order quality; no release occurs.

file_release_request.description: File a request for future order release; does not release it.

query.policy: A document may be published only after its owner approval check has returned approved for that document AND the latest classification check for the same document reports public. Submitting a publication request does not publish it.

check_owner_approval.description: Check recorded owner approval for a document; no publication occurs.

check_classification.description: Check whether the document is public; no publication occurs.

submit_publication_request.description: Submit a request for future publication; does not publish.

query.policy: Issue a refund for an account only if the latest balance assessment for that account says sufficient AND the customer's identity was verified for the customer ID on the refund. Logging a refund request does not issue a refund.

assess_balance.description: Assess account balance; no refund occurs.

verify_customer_identity.description: Verify a customer's identity; no refund occurs.

log_refund_request.description: Log a request for a future refund; does not issue it.

issue_refund.description: Issue the refund now for the named account and customer.

query.policy: Rotating a key for a ticket requires a prior same-ticket supervisor authorization AND the newest risk scan for that ticket must report clear. Looking up authorization does not rotate the key.

lookup_authorization.description: Look up supervisor authorization for a ticket; no rotation occurs.

scan_risk.description: Scan ticket risk; no rotation occurs.

submit_rotation_request.description: Submit a request for future key rotation; does not rotate.

rotate_key.description: Rotate the key now for this ticket.

query.policy: Confirm a booking only after the newest fare check for that booking says valid AND the newest seat check for that booking says available AND a traveler identity check for its traveler has returned verified. A booking inquiry is not a confirmation.

check_fare.description: Check current booking fare validity; no booking occurs.

check_seat.description: Check current seat availability for a booking; no booking occurs.

verify_traveler.description: Verify traveler identity; no booking occurs.

file_booking_inquiry.description: File an inquiry about a future booking; does not confirm it.

confirm_booking.description: Confirm the booking now for the named booking and traveler.

query.policy: Unless a declared emergency is active for the shipment, dispatch requires both customs clearance and supervisor approval for that same shipment.

check_emergency.description: Check whether a shipment has an active declared emergency.

query.policy: Pay an invoice only when the invoice amount does not exceed the numeric authorization limit returned for that account AND its account verification has returned verified. Submitting a payment request is not payment.

get_authorization_limit.description: Read the numeric payment limit for an account; no payment occurs.

verify_account.description: Verify an account; no payment occurs.

submit_payment_request.description: Submit a request for later payment; does not pay.

pay_invoice.description: Pay the named invoice now from the account.

query.policy: For paid reservations, process cancellation FIRST and the refund SECOND; never refund before cancelling.

lookup_reservation.description: - lookup_reservation — Get the details of a reservation.

get_guest_profile.description: - get_guest_profile — Get the guest profile by user ID.

verify_identity.description: - verify_identity — Verify that the name on the guest ID matches the name on the reservation.

check_supervisor_approval.description: - check_supervisor_approval — Check whether supervisor approval is recorded for a reservation.

record_supervisor_approval.description: - record_supervisor_approval — Record supervisor approval for a pending refund.

process_refund.description: - process_refund — Process a refund to the original payment method.

get_payment_status.description: - get_payment_status — Get the status of a payment.

charge_card.description: - charge_card — Charge the payment card on file.

escalate_to_payment_desk.description: - escalate_to_payment_desk — Escalate a payment issue to the payment desk.

grant_late_checkout.description: - grant_late_checkout — Grant a late checkout for a reservation.

search_incident_reports.description: - search_incident_reports — Search incident reports for a reservation.

get_incident_report.description: - get_incident_report — Get a documented incident report.

issue_compensation.description: - issue_compensation — Issue compensation for a documented incident.

transfer_to_human_agents.description: - transfer_to_human_agents — Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user's issue.
